name: Hidden Treasures
source:
Goblins. We usually see these mischievous, green creatures as obstacles for your adventuring party. Killing goblins means easy experience for a lowly adventurer. Kissing goblins on the other hand…

You’re in for a far greater adventure!

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/altomvisual/hidden-treasures-2]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
哥布林。我们通常将这些调皮的绿色生物视为冒险队伍的障碍。对于低等的冒险者来说，杀死哥布林意味着轻松的经历。另一方面，正在亲吻妖精……

你将迎来一场更伟大的冒险！

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/altomvisual/hidden-treasures-2]Kickstarter[/url]]
